title: Travel-Readiness Phrase Coverage
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lesson:complete phrase_domain=travel
| stats dc(phrase_id) as phrases_covered, sum(eval(if(mastered="yes",1,0))) as mastered by language
| eval mastery_pct=round(100*mastered/phrases_covered,1)
| sort - mastery_pct
description: Measures how complete your everyday travel phrase set is for each language you are preparing to use abroad.
value: Travel readiness is a practical milestone that motivates study better than abstract XP totals.
implementation: Tag lesson phrases by domain and mastery state; summarize travel phrase coverage by language.
visualization: Table of languages with travel phrase mastery percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It checks whether you have really learned the practical phrases you need before a trip.
